title: Specifications index
introduction:
I use this index to find the right specification sheet before reaching for a tool. Choose the system, then match the engine, transmission or fitted-equipment wording in the topic name. Those qualifiers are the address on the envelope: leave one out and the answer can land at the wrong car.

Open the matching topic for its values, units and applicable conditions. This index identifies the available subjects; the selected specification sheet supplies the details.

edits.why: The entries organize specification lookups by system and configuration.
